Name: Seasonal Cabin Style Farmhouse
Author: windvalley
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]

This mod aims to use the designs of the player cabin and the size of the main farmhouse to create unique player farmhouses that match. There are 6 choices of houses, Beach, Log, Neighbor, Plank, Rustic, and Stone. All the farmhouses have seasonal versions for fall and winter. The second upgrade also allows for color change as well.

Keep in mind this is my very first mod, so let me know if I missed something or if it is not working quite right. 

[b]Install Instructions

[/b]Install like most mods. Extract the zip folder into the Stardew Valley mods folder. It should only require having [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Cabin]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended for ease of use, but should not be required.

[b]Config[/b]

"Style": Changes which cabin style the farmhouse will match. Choose between Beach, Log, Neighbor, Plank, Rustic, or Stone.

"Recolor": Changes the color of the farmhouse to match either the vanilla palette or the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367] vibrant pastoral recolor[/url] palette. Choose between Vanilla or Vibrant Pastoral.

"Matching Shipping Bin": Turn on or off. Changes the Shipping bin to match the color of the selected farmhouse deck's final upgrade.

"Matching Pet Bowl": Turn on or off. Changes the default pet bowl to match the color of the selected farmhouse deck's final upgrade.

"Matching Mailbox": Turn on or off. Changes the mailbox so that the wood matches the deck color and the metal matches the chimney color of the selected farmhouse's final upgrade.


[b]Known Bugs

[/b]If you exit to to title and change the farmhouse style and reload the game, the house paint mask does not update. That means trying to change the color of an upgraded farmhouse will result in using the previous houses paint mask, which will look very odd. The only fix I could find is to just quit to desktop and reload. This shouldn't really be a problem unless you are very indecisive. 


[b]Similar mods

[/b]If this mod is not quite what you are looking for check these mods out:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24757?tab=description]Cabin House [/url]change the farmhouse to look just like the cabins, same size and everything.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25081]Cabins to Farmhouse[/url] changes the cabins to look like the farmhouse.
